# awscc_iot_stream (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS IoT Stream. A stream is a publicly addressable resource that is an abstraction for a list of files that can be transferred to an IoT device.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Attributes List) The files to stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `role_arn` (String) An IAM role that allows the IoT service principal to access your S3 files.
- `stream_id` (String) The stream ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the stream.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Metadata which can be used to manage streams. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream.
- `created_at` (String) The date when the stream was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The date when the stream was last updated.
- `stream_version` (Number) The stream version.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Optional:

- `file_id` (Number) The file ID.
- `s3_location` (Attributes) The location of the file in S3. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files--s3_location))

<a id="nestedatt--files--s3_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files.s3_location`

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) The S3 bucket.
- `key` (String) The S3 key.
- `version` (String) The S3 bucket version.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag's key.
- `value` (String) The tag's value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_stream.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the stream

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_stream.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_iot_stream.example "arn"
```
